data_description.tolerance: Readings further than this from every cat are logged as unidentified.
data_description.smoothing: How much each visit moves the learned weight (0 = never, 1 = jump to the latest reading).
data_description.min_weight: Filters out empty-box readings and noise.
data_description.notify_targets: Notify services, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone. Photos are attached on mobile app targets.
data_description.record_unidentified: Off: readings that don't match any cat are ignored completely (no log, count, event or notification).

data_description.alert_hours: Hours without a visit before alerting. 0 = off.
